round_calculator_prompt: Enter an amount above and the estimate will appear here.
round_calculator_subtitle: A rough ownership estimate from the published terms.
round_close_body: The round stops accepting new indications of interest. Its terms, commitments and history stay exactly as they are.
round_closing_confirm_body: Confirm that {amount} arrived and is reconciled. The investor is emailed a confirmation.
round_closing_confirm_body_no_member: Confirm that {amount} arrived and is reconciled. This investor is not a member of the workspace, so nobody is emailed.
round_closing_error_envelope_not_open: This agreement is already finished, so it cannot be voided.
round_closing_error_live: The vendor still has this agreement, so it may still be signed. Void it before sending a new one.
round_closing_error_not_signable: Only a soft or verbal commitment can be sent for signature.
round_closing_error_not_wired: Only a wired commitment can be confirmed.
round_closing_error_provider: The e-signature vendor refused or failed the request. Try again, or check the vendor connection.
round_closing_error_request_open: An agreement is already out for signature for this commitment. Void it first to send a new one.
round_closing_error_round_not_open: The round has not been opened yet.
round_closing_error_signer_email_missing: There is no email address on record for this investor. Enter the signer's name and email.
round_closing_error_template_missing: No subscription agreement template is set up for the round.
round_closing_error_template_unsupported: The connected e-signature vendor cannot send documents from a template.
round_closing_go_to_settings: Set up the template in round settings
round_closing_hint: Each commitment moves from agreement sent to signed, wired and confirmed. The steps come from the signatures and payments on record.
round_closing_member_confirmed_body: The company confirmed your investment on {date}.
round_closing_member_confirmed_body_unda: The company has confirmed your investment.
round_closing_member_dead_body: The documents can no longer be signed from the earlier email. The company will send new ones if they are needed.
round_closing_member_dead_title: This signature request is no longer active
round_closing_member_email_body: Your subscription documents were sent to you by email from the company's e-signature service. Sign them there; this checklist updates once the signature is recorded.
round_closing_member_email_other_body: The subscription documents were emailed to the investor for signature.
round_closing_member_stalled_body: If you have the email with the signing link, it may still work. The company has been told and will send new documents if they are needed.
round_closing_member_stalled_title: The signing service reported a problem
round_closing_member_subtitle: Where your commitment stands on the way to closing.
round_closing_message_hint: Optional. The e-signature vendor includes it in the email with the signing link.
round_closing_no_vendor_body: Subscription agreements are sent for signature through an e-signature vendor.
round_closing_prefill_empty: No fields are prefilled. The investor fills in everything.
round_closing_prefill_hint: The template's field name, exactly as the vendor spells it, and what to fill it with when the agreement is sent.
round_closing_refused: The agreement could not be sent
round_closing_send_body: The subscription agreement for {amount} is generated from the round's template and emailed to the investor to sign.
round_closing_send_named: Send the subscription agreement to {name} for signature
round_closing_settings_hint: The subscription agreement that closing sends for e-signature, and what fills its fields.
round_closing_signer_hint: This investor is not a member of the workspace. Leave the email empty to use the address on record.
round_closing_template_ref_hint: The template's ID at your e-signature vendor. Leave empty until the template exists.
round_closing_template_role_hint: The signer role the investor fills in the vendor template. DocuSign and multi-role DocuSeal templates match the signer by this name, so it must be spelled exactly as in the template. Usually Signer.
round_closing_void_body: The agreement is cancelled at the e-signature vendor and the investor can no longer sign it. You can send a new one afterwards.
round_commitment_add_hint: For somebody who committed outside the portal. It counts towards the allocation like any other.
round_commitments_hint: The system of record for money in this round. The allocation tracker and the CRM pipeline both read it.
round_consent_label: I have read {document} (version {version}), my answers above are true, and I agree to sign and receive these records electronically.
round_consent_plain: My answers above are true, and I agree to sign and receive these records electronically.
round_decline_body: They are told the company is not taking this forward. Nothing else changes.
round_evidence_bad_type: That file type cannot be accepted. Send a PDF, PNG or JPEG.
round_evidence_hint: The company needs to see something that supports your accreditation — a letter from your accountant or lawyer, or a statement. It is encrypted, only company staff can open it, and it is deleted once the decision is made.
round_evidence_too_large: That file is larger than 10 MB. Send a smaller one.
round_evidence_types: PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB.
round_field_show_progress: Show investors how much of the target has been raised
round_field_summary_hint: Markdown. Investors see this on the round page.
round_interest_amount_hint: Roughly what you are thinking of investing. Nothing is committed by typing it.
round_interest_amount_minimum: The company has set a minimum of {amount} for this round.
round_interest_closed: This round is not open for new indications of interest.
round_interest_entity_name_hint: The fund, company or trust that would invest.
round_interest_not_offer: This is not an offer to sell securities.
round_interest_not_offer_neutral: This is not an offer to sell securities and nothing here is directed at anyone in a place where it would be.
round_interest_note_hint: Questions, timing, or anything the company should know.
round_interest_submitted_body: The company has it. Somebody will look at it and come back to you; nothing is committed on either side in the meantime.
round_interest_subtitle: Tell the company roughly what you are thinking of. This is not an offer to sell securities, and nothing here commits either side.
round_investor_empty_body: There is nothing to show here yet. The company will publish the round when it is ready.
round_investor_subtitle: The instrument, the terms and where the round stands.
round_list_empty_body: Create one to record the instrument, the terms and who has committed what.
round_method_professional_letter: Letter from a lawyer, accountant or adviser
round_my_submissions_empty: You have not indicated interest in this round.
round_myverif_already_pending: You already have a verification in progress.
round_myverif_continue_hint: The rest of the verification happens on {provider}'s own page. You will come back here when you are done.
round_myverif_embedded: To continue with {provider}, open the investor portal at its own address. Verification cannot continue inside this embedded page.
round_myverif_expired: This verification has expired. A new one is needed before the company can rely on it again.
round_myverif_invite_sent: {provider} has emailed you a link to continue. Check your inbox, and your spam folder if it has not arrived.
round_myverif_none: You have not started a verification yet. Starting one lets the company confirm your accreditation, either by reviewing documents you send or through a verification service it uses.
round_myverif_not_advice: This is information about the process, not legal or investment advice.
round_myverif_pending_review: The company is reviewing your verification. You will be told once a decision is made.
round_myverif_pending_upload: The company reviews this itself. Send a document that supports your accreditation; you will be told once a decision is made.
round_myverif_rejected: This verification did not confirm your accreditation. If something has changed, you can start a new one, or contact the company.
round_myverif_renewal_not_recertified: Your renewal is not finished yet: {provider} still shows your previous accreditation. Complete the renewal with {provider} and this page will update.
round_myverif_see_card: To continue your accreditation verification, see “Accreditation verification” on this page.
round_myverif_start_failed: Your verification with {provider} could not be set up. The company can see this and will be in touch about how to continue.
round_myverif_starting_slow: Setting up your verification with {provider} is taking longer than usual. Check again in a few minutes.
round_myverif_starting_stuck: Your verification with {provider} is still being set up. Check back later; there is nothing you need to do now.
round_myverif_subtitle: How the company confirms you are an accredited investor.
round_myverif_vendor_ended: This verification with {provider} can no longer continue. If you need to be verified, contact the company.
round_myverif_verified_until: Your accreditation was verified through {provider}. It is valid until {date}.
round_never_opened: This round has not been opened yet.
round_new_hint: A round starts in planning. Nothing is visible to investors until you open it.
round_non_accredited_warning_body: {count} of the accepted investors named no accreditation category, and Rule 506(b) admits at most {limit}.
round_non_accredited_warning_not_blockin: This is a prompt, not a block: nothing has been refused. Talk to counsel about how you want to handle it.
round_open_body: Investors will be able to see the terms and indicate interest. Only one round can be open at a time, and the round needs terms before it can open.
round_path_explain_none: No accreditation questions apply to this round.
round_path_explain_self_attested: You will be asked which of the accreditation categories apply to you. Answering that none apply is a real answer and does not disqualify you.
round_path_explain_self_certified: At this amount the company may rely on your written representations rather than asking you to be verified. You will be asked to confirm two things below.
round_path_explain_verification_required: The company has to verify your accreditation before it can accept. Once you have sent this you will be asked to upload something that supports it.
round_progress_label: {committed} committed and {soft} soft-circled of a {target} target: {percent} committed.
round_questionnaire_hint: Tick every one that applies to you. Your answers are recorded with the version of the questionnaire you saw.
round_questionnaire_none: None of these apply to me
round_questionnaire_note: Tell the company about your investing experience
round_questionnaire_note_hint: Under Rule 506(b) the company may still accept you, so a few lines about your experience with investments like this one helps it decide.
round_queue_hint: Accepting one turns it into a soft commitment. No payment instructions are sent by either action.
round_reps_hint: At {amount} or more the company may rely on these two written representations instead of verifying you. Both are required.
round_reps_not_financed: I am not borrowing from anyone else to fund this investment.
round_reverification_auto_start: Start the renewal with the vendor automatically
round_reverification_auto_start_hint: When a vendor is connected, a new verification is opened at reminder time without waiting for the investor. The vendor may charge for each one.
round_reverification_body: Verifications expire. Investors are reminded once before theirs does.
round_reverification_days: Remind investors this many days before expiry
round_settings_currency_hint: Three letters, such as USD or EUR. New rounds start with this.
round_settings_evidence_hint: Two settings, both about data you would rather not keep.
round_settings_retention_hint: Days after a verification is decided. The nightly job deletes the file and keeps the decision.
round_settings_subtitle: Evidence retention and the currency new rounds start with.
round_tasks_hint: The short list of what still has to happen before the round closes.
round_terms_cap_note: The highest valuation at which your money converts into shares. A lower valuation later gives you more of the company, not less.
round_terms_discount_note: You convert at this much less than the price the next round's investors pay.
round_terms_form_hint: Saving writes a new revision. The old one is kept and marked superseded, so what was on the page when somebody subscribed stays provable.
round_terms_history_hint: Every revision, newest first. Terms are never edited in place.
round_terms_interest_note: Simple interest accrues on the amount you lend and converts along with it.
round_terms_liquidation_non_participatin: If the company is sold, this much comes back to these investors before anyone else is paid. They take that or their shares, whichever is worth more — not both.
round_terms_liquidation_participating: If the company is sold, this much comes back to these investors first, and they then share what is left alongside everyone else.
round_terms_maturity_note: When the note falls due if it has not converted before then.
round_terms_mfn_note: Whether better terms given to a later investor on the same instrument are extended to you as well.
round_terms_none: No terms have been published for this round yet.
round_terms_note_note: You lend the company money. It converts into shares at the next priced round, with interest.
round_terms_option_pool_note: Shares set aside for employees. A larger pool dilutes the existing holders, not the new ones.
round_terms_pre_money_note: What the company is worth before this round's money goes in.
round_terms_price_per_share_note: What one share costs in this round.
round_terms_priced_note: You buy shares now at an agreed price. Nothing converts later.
round_terms_pro_rata_note: Whether you may invest again in the next round to keep the same share of the company.
round_terms_safe_post_money_note: Your share is worked out against the cap after this round's money is counted, so later SAFEs in this round do not dilute it.
round_terms_safe_pre_money_note: Your share is worked out against the cap before this round's money is counted, so other investors in the same round dilute it.
round_terms_saved: Terms saved as a new revision
round_verification_check_conflict: This verification is no longer waiting on a vendor. The list has been refreshed.
round_verification_decide_hint: Verified needs both a method and evidence. Which evidence depends on the method.
round_verification_expiry_hint: A letter from an adviser is usually good for 90 days; other methods for twelve months. Leave blank for the default.
round_verification_member_erased_body: This member's data has been erased, so they cannot be marked verified. You can still reject the verification to clear it from the queue.
round_verification_method_hint: A document review or an adviser's letter needs a file. A third-party service or the minimum-investment representations need a note saying what you relied on.
round_verification_needs_evidence: Verified cannot be recorded until the method is chosen and the evidence it needs is here.
round_verification_note_hint: What you relied on. Kept with the decision.
round_verification_override_body: A decision recorded here settles the verification; a later answer from {vendor} is ignored.
round_verification_vendor_error_connecti: The vendor connection changed. Decide this one yourself.
round_verification_vendor_error_imported: Imported from another installation. The vendor is not checked from here; decide it yourself.
round_verification_vendor_error_member_e: The member's data was erased. The vendor is no longer checked; reject it to clear it.
round_verification_vendor_error_member_i: The member is not active, so nothing was sent to the vendor.
round_verification_vendor_error_polling_: The vendor has not answered for a long time and is no longer checked. Decide this one yourself.
round_verification_vendor_error_renewal_: The vendor has not re-certified the investor yet. It is checked again later.
round_verification_vendor_error_start_fa: The vendor verification could not be started. Decide this one yourself, or ask the investor to start again.
round_verification_vendor_error_start_ti: The vendor verification did not start after several attempts. Decide this one yourself, or ask the investor to start again.
round_verifications_subtitle: Accreditation evidence and the decisions made on it.
round_warning_non_accredited_limit: That acceptance takes the round to the Rule 506(b) limit of 35 investors with no accreditation category.
round_withdraw_body: The company stops considering it. You can indicate interest again afterwards.
search_empty_body: Try fewer or different words. Search only finds what you have access to.
search_field_hint: Press slash or Control+K to jump here.
search_gated_body: Accept the required agreement to open this and see what it says.
search_prompt: Type a word or two to search documents, pages and updates.
search_subtitle: Documents, pages and updates you have access to.
sessions_subtitle: Where you are signed in right now.
settings_subtitle: Your profile, sessions and sign-in methods.
setup_company_body: The name, tagline, colour and logo your investors will see. Everything here can be changed later in Admin → Branding.
setup_company_logo_body: Upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP, or let us pull one from your website. SVG is not accepted.
setup_complete_body: This portal already has an owner. Sign in to continue.
setup_dataroom_body: Pick a folder structure to start from. Folders that already exist are kept, and you can rename or add to any of them afterwards.
setup_domain_added: Publish both records at your DNS provider. Verifying them happens on the Domains screen whenever you are ready — it is not part of the setup.
setup_domain_body: Three answers, all fine. Nothing here blocks the rest of the setup, and you can change your mind later.
setup_domain_custom_help: investors.yourcompany.com, for instance: two DNS records and a verification.
setup_domain_embed_help: Put the portal inside a page of your own site with the snippet from Admin → Embed. Investors then see your site's address, so the portal's own address matters less.
setup_domain_embed_label: I'll put the portal inside my own site
setup_domain_later: You can add a domain later under Admin → Domains.
setup_domain_subdomain_help: {origin} works today and needs no DNS at all.
setup_domain_subdomain_label: Keep the address it came with
setup_domain_title: Where should investors find this portal?
setup_done_body: {workspace} is ready. Here are three things to do next.
setup_done_next_brand: Add your logo and colours under Admin → Branding.
setup_done_next_invite: Invite your first investors from Admin → People.
setup_done_next_update: Write and send your first investor update.
setup_done_url_hint: This address always works. To use a domain of your own, add it under Admin → Domains; to show the portal inside your website, copy the snippet from Admin → Embed.
setup_hosted_body: Workspaces on this service are created by signing up. If you already have one, sign in.
setup_hosted_title: There is nothing to set up here
setup_invites_body: One address per line, or separated by commas. They join as investors and see nothing at all until you share a document or send an update.
setup_invites_failed_conflict: already a member of this workspace
setup_invites_invalid: Not an email address, and left out: {list}
setup_mail_body: Sign-in codes, invitations and updates go out through the configured mailer ({driver}). Send yourself a test to confirm it works.
setup_mail_sent: Handed to the mail provider in {ms} ms. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
setup_modules_body: The essentials are already on. Switch anything else on now, or later in Admin → Modules — nothing here is permanent.
setup_offering_506b_body: A private round under Rule 506(b), or its equivalent where you are. Nothing is advertised: everyone who sees the material was invited because you already knew them.
setup_offering_506c_body: A round advertised publicly under Rule 506(c). You may market the raise to anyone, but every investor has to be verified as accredited — and for this offering the switch cannot be undone.
setup_offering_body: This sets the defaults for who may see what and which disclaimers get attached. Pick the one that describes your round today; you can change it later, with one exception below.
setup_offering_locked: This offering is already at Rule 506(c), and that cannot be reversed. Falling back is a new offering, not a setting.
setup_offering_non_us_body: A round run under another jurisdiction's private-placement rules. The portal applies the conservative defaults and leaves the specifics to your counsel.
setup_offering_none_body: You are not raising right now. The portal stays a private, invitation-only place to keep people up to date.
setup_owner_body: You will be the workspace owner. Investors and staff are invited afterwards.
setup_owner_email_hint: You sign in with a code sent to this address (plus a passkey or authenticator app if you add one).
setup_owner_slug_taken: A workspace with this address already exists. Choose a different name.
setup_owner_workspace_hint: The workspace address will be {slug} on {host}. You can add a custom domain later.
setup_recovery_codes_body: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator.
setup_required_body: {name} has not been set up yet. Open the setup wizard with the setup token printed in the server logs.
setup_secure_body: Owners can do anything in the portal, so add a second factor now. You can also do this later in Settings → Security.
setup_secure_bound_action: Sign in with an email code
setup_secure_bound_body: You signed in to this workspace through {instance}, and a sign-in passed on that way cannot change your account. Sign in here with a code sent by email instead (choose the email code, not Continue), then add an authenticator app.
setup_secure_bound_stepped_body: That confirmation did not verify you (some security keys do not check a PIN or fingerprint), and a sign-in passed on from {instance} cannot add an authenticator app. Sign in here with a code sent by email instead: that sign-in can confirm your passkey and then add an authenticator app.
setup_secure_confirm_body: Your account already has a passkey or an authenticator app. Confirm it's you with it to go on.
setup_secure_passkey_body: Sign in with Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello or a security key. Recommended.
setup_secure_passkey_confirm_body: Passkey added. Confirm it's you with it once to finish: press the button, then use the passkey when your browser asks.
setup_secure_passkey_done: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
setup_secure_password_totp_title: Set a password and an authenticator app
setup_secure_stale_body: This sign-in is too old to add a passkey or an authenticator app. Sign in again and add one then.
setup_secure_stepped_body: That confirmation did not verify you: some security keys do not check a PIN or fingerprint. Add an authenticator app, or confirm again with a passkey that asks for a PIN or biometric.
setup_secure_totp_body: Six-digit codes from Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy or similar.
setup_secure_totp_reconfirm: Confirmed. Enter the current code from the app again to finish.
setup_step_up_body: Owner accounts need a passkey or an authenticator app before they can change anything in the portal. Add one and the rest of the wizard opens up.
setup_storage_body: Documents are stored with the {driver} driver. This writes a small file, reads it back and deletes it.
setup_storage_ok: Wrote, read and deleted a probe object in {ms} ms.
setup_subtitle: A few steps to get {name} ready. You can change everything later in admin.
setup_token_body_env: The setup token is the SETUP_TOKEN value from the server's configuration.
setup_token_body_logs: The server printed a one-time setup token when it started. Find the line that says “first-run setup” in its logs, or run “fundroom setup-token” inside the container.
setup_token_hint: Only whoever runs this server can see it. It stops working once the owner exists.
setup_token_invalid: That token does not match. Check the server logs and try again.
setup_update_body: Start from a template and save it as a draft. Nothing is sent to anyone until you publish it from Admin → Updates.
setup_update_created: Draft “{title}” saved. Finish it in Admin → Updates.
setup_update_existing: This workspace already has {count} draft or sent update, so the wizard will not create another. Finish it in Admin → Updates.
share_link_accept_body: {workspace} asks everyone who follows this link to agree to the terms below before the room opens.
share_link_accept_title: One thing to agree to first
share_link_body: Enter your email address and {workspace} will send you a six-digit code. You will not see anything until the code is verified.
share_link_done_body: Your agreement is on record. Keep the certificate if you want your own copy of what you signed and when.
share_link_error_email_not_allowed: That address is not on this link’s list. Try the address the link was sent to.
share_link_error_passcode_locked: Too many passcode attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
share_link_footnote: We do not say whether an address is on the list: every answer here looks the same.
share_link_invalid_body: It may have expired, been withdrawn, or already been used as many times as it was meant to be. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
share_link_passcode_hint: The person who sent you this link will have given you a passcode separately.
share_link_title: You have been sent a link
share_links_audience_help: Leave both empty and any verified email address may use the link. Some offering modes do not permit that.
share_links_capabilities: What they may do with it
share_links_create_body: The link’s address is shown once, when it is created. Nothing can show it again.
share_links_domains_hint: One per line, without the @. Subdomains are not included: acme.com admits jane@acme.com and refuses jane@mail.acme.com — add mail.acme.com if you want it.
share_links_emails_hint: One per line. Only these addresses may use the link.
share_links_error_audience_too_open: A link that any verified email can use is not permitted here. Name the domains or the addresses that may use it.
share_links_error_audience_too_open_name: Under {status} a link has to name its audience: general solicitation is not permitted. Add the email domains or the exact addresses that may use it.
share_links_error_not_permitted: This workspace’s offering mode does not permit share links.
share_links_error_not_permitted_named: Share links are not permitted while the offering mode is {status}. Change the mode first, on the Legal & compliance screen.
share_links_error_unknown_resource_kind: Nothing on this install can serve that kind of resource.
share_links_exhausted_body: It will not admit anybody new. The people it already admitted keep their access — revoke the link if you want to take that away.
share_links_exhausted_title: This link has reached its limit
share_links_groups_hint: Whatever a group can reach, everyone who uses this link can reach.
share_links_label_hint: Only you see this. “Sent to Northwind at the Q3 meeting” beats “link 4”.
share_links_max_uses_hint: How many different people may come in.
share_links_minted_body: This is the only time it is shown. Close this and it is gone; you would have to create another.
share_links_minted_title: Here is the link — copy it now
share_links_no_grants: Carries no grants of its own; access comes from the groups it puts people in.
share_links_none_body: Create one to give somebody access without knowing their address in advance.
share_links_passcode_field_hint: At least six characters, sent separately from the link. A forwarded address without it admits nobody.
share_links_paused_body: A paused link admits nobody new AND suspends the access of everyone it has already admitted. Resume it to give that access back.
share_links_revoke_body: The link stops working immediately and cannot be brought back. Choose below what happens to the people it let in.
share_links_revoke_memberships: Also end the access this link gave the people who used it
share_links_revoke_memberships_off: They keep the access this link gave them. Revoking the link only stops new people getting in.
share_links_revoke_memberships_on: Their access through this link ends now. They stay members, and anything they hold from a group or another grant is untouched.
share_links_revoked_all_ok: Link revoked, and the access it gave has ended.
share_links_subtitle: A link that admits somebody you have not invited: they verify an email, pass the link’s checks, and become a member of this workspace.
share_links_target_hint: Optional. Without one the link still works: people come in through the groups below.
share_links_visits_none: Nobody has used this link yet.
share_links_watermark: Watermark everything they open through this link
share_no_rules: No rule applies to this person here.
share_nobody: Nobody outside your team has access yet.
share_subtitle: Who can see this and why. Grants add up across a person, their groups and their role; the nearest rule wins.
shown_once_warning: This is the only time it is shown. It cannot be shown again once you leave or reload this page.
signup_code_subtitle: If {email} can be used for a new workspace, a 6-digit code is on its way. Enter it to create the workspace.
signup_done_body: Then continue to your workspace to finish setting it up. If it asks you to sign in, use the same email address; if it asks you to confirm it's you, use the passkey or app you added.
signup_done_secure: First, add a passkey or an authenticator app here. Owner accounts need one before they can change anything in the workspace.
signup_done_secure_later: Add one in your workspace instead
signup_done_unconfirmed: Your passkey has not confirmed it's you yet. If you continue anyway, your workspace will ask you to confirm it's you again before you can change anything.
signup_email_help: You become the workspace's owner and sign in with this address.
signup_legal_name_help: As registered, including the legal form — used for invoices and compliance checks.
signup_plan_help: What the workspace starts on. You can change plans later.
signup_plan_paid: A subscription: you can subscribe from the billing page once the workspace is created.
signup_region_elsewhere: {region} is run by a separate deployment. Sign up there to keep your workspace's data in {region}.
signup_region_help: Your host runs more than one region. A workspace's data stays in the region you choose here, unless your host later moves it (they tell you before they do).
signup_slug_invalid: Use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens only, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
signup_slug_taken: That address is taken. Choose a different one.
signup_subtitle: Set up an investor portal on {instance}. We email you a code to confirm the address.
signup_terms: I accept the terms of service of {instance} on behalf of the company.
signup_terms_changed: The terms of service have changed since this page was opened. Read them again and tick the box to accept the current version.
sso_admin_breakglass_body: If your identity provider fails, an owner who has a passkey or an authenticator app can still sign in without it. Make sure at least one owner has set one up before requiring single sign-on.
sso_admin_certs_help: One or more PEM certificates (-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----). Add the next one here before your provider rotates.
sso_admin_certs_keep: Leave blank to keep the saved certificates, or paste PEM certificates to replace them.
sso_admin_connection_body: One OpenID Connect or SAML connection per workspace. Its settings are checked with the identity provider before anything is saved.
sso_admin_delete_body: Staff signed in through it are signed out, the requirement is turned off, and staff sign in with email codes and passkeys again.
sso_admin_domain_added: {domain} added. Publish the TXT record, then check it.
sso_admin_domain_remove_body: New accounts from this domain stop being created automatically. Existing staff keep their access.
sso_admin_domain_txt_body: Publish this TXT record in the domain's DNS, then check it.
sso_admin_domain_verify_refused_title: The domain could not be verified
sso_admin_domains_body: Prove you own your email domains with a DNS TXT record. Only verified domains get just-in-time accounts and SCIM users. Subdomains are verified separately.
sso_admin_enabled_help: Turning this off also stops requiring it.
sso_admin_enforce_api_keys: Existing API keys keep working when single sign-on is required. Revoke any you no longer want on the API keys page.
sso_admin_enforce_off_help: Staff may also sign in with email codes and passkeys.
sso_admin_enforce_staff_help: Staff can use this workspace only after signing in through your identity provider. Investors are not affected.
sso_admin_error_discovery_failed: We could not load the provider's discovery document from the issuer URL.
sso_admin_error_domain_invalid: That is not a valid domain name. Enter just the domain, like example.com.
sso_admin_error_domain_taken: Another workspace on this server has already verified this domain.
sso_admin_error_domain_unverified: The TXT record was not found yet. DNS changes can take a while to show up; check again later.
sso_admin_error_enforce_never_signed_in: Run a successful test sign-in first, so requiring it cannot lock staff out.
sso_admin_error_enforce_not_enabled: Turn the connection on before requiring it.
sso_admin_error_invalid_certificate: A certificate is not a valid PEM certificate, or it has expired.
sso_admin_error_invalid_config: The identity provider settings are not valid.
sso_admin_error_invalid_metadata: The metadata XML could not be read, or has no HTTP-Redirect sign-in URL or signing certificate.
sso_admin_error_issuer_mismatch: The discovery document names a different issuer. Use the issuer URL exactly as the provider states it.
sso_admin_error_not_configured: There is no identity provider connected.
sso_admin_error_protocol_unavailable: Your operator does not offer this protocol.
sso_admin_error_scim_token_limit: There are already two SCIM tokens. Revoke one before creating another.
sso_admin_error_secret_required: Enter the client secret: it is needed for a new connection or a different issuer.
sso_admin_error_session_restricted: This session came from single sign-on and can't change account security settings; sign in with your email to do this.
sso_admin_field_issuer_help: The provider's issuer; its discovery document must be at /.well-known/openid-configuration below it.
sso_admin_field_metadata_help: We read the entity ID, the HTTP-Redirect sign-in URL and the signing certificates from it.
sso_admin_field_mfa_values: Values that mean MFA was used
sso_admin_field_mfa_values_help_oidc: One acr value per line. An amr claim naming a second factor also counts.
sso_admin_field_name_help: Shown on the sign-in button, for example "Acme Okta".
sso_admin_forbidden: You need single sign-on access to see this page.
sso_admin_jit_help: Only for email addresses in a verified domain below. Anyone else needs an invitation first.
sso_admin_jit_toggle: Create a staff account on first sign-in
sso_admin_mfa_not_trusted: Not trusted: owners and admins confirm with a passkey or authenticator app
sso_admin_mfa_trust_help: Only if your provider always requires MFA. Otherwise owners and admins are asked for their passkey or authenticator app here too.
sso_admin_mfa_trust_toggle: Trust the provider's MFA for every sign-in
sso_admin_none_offered_body: Your operator has not turned on OpenID Connect or SAML for this server.
sso_admin_not_connected: No identity provider is connected, so staff sign in with email codes and passkeys.
sso_admin_not_connected_read_only: Only the workspace owner can connect one.
sso_admin_plan_provider_changed: Switching identity provider isn't on your plan. Keep the saved value to update this provider's credentials.
sso_admin_plan_same_provider: On your plan you can update this provider's credentials, not connect a different provider.
sso_admin_plan_switch_refused: Switching identity provider isn't on your plan. Keep the current issuer or entity ID to update this provider's credentials.
sso_admin_policy_read_enforced: Required for staff. Owners with a passkey or authenticator app can still sign in without it.
sso_admin_policy_read_off: Off: staff sign in with email codes and passkeys.
sso_admin_policy_read_optional: On and optional: staff may also sign in with email codes and passkeys.
sso_admin_protocol_oidc_help: Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace and most modern providers.
sso_admin_protocol_saml_help: For providers that only speak SAML, or when your IT team prefers it.
sso_admin_read_only: Only the workspace owner can change single sign-on. You can see how it is set up.
sso_admin_save_refused_title: The identity provider settings were not saved
sso_admin_scim_body: Let your identity provider create, suspend and remove staff accounts. It never changes owners, investors or anyone's name or email.
sso_admin_scim_disabled_body: Your operator has turned off SCIM provisioning on this server.
sso_admin_scim_groups_empty: Your identity provider has not pushed any groups yet.
sso_admin_scim_groups_help: Choose the staff role each group gives. A member of several groups gets the highest: Admin, then Legal, Finance, Editor, Viewer. Members of no mapped group get the just-in-time role (Viewer without a connection). Owners are never changed.
sso_admin_scim_token_limit_note: Two tokens is the limit. Revoke one to create another.
sso_admin_scim_token_name_help: So you can tell tokens apart, for example "Entra ID 2026".
sso_admin_scim_token_reveal_body: Paste it into your identity provider as the secret token, with the SCIM base URL above.
sso_admin_scim_token_revoke_body: Your identity provider can no longer provision with it. Accounts it created stay as they are.
sso_admin_scim_tokens_body: Your identity provider sends one of these as its bearer token. Up to two at a time, so you can rotate without a gap.
sso_admin_scim_tokens_outlive: A token keeps working after the person who created it leaves the workspace. Revoke it here when it is no longer needed.
sso_admin_scim_users_empty: Your identity provider has not provisioned anyone yet.
sso_admin_secret_issuer_changed: The issuer changed, so enter this provider's secret.
sso_admin_secret_keep: Leave blank to keep the saved secret.
sso_admin_sp_after_save: The redirect URI, ACS URL and entity ID include the connection's ID, so they appear here once it is saved.
sso_admin_sp_body_oidc: Add this redirect URI to the app registration.
sso_admin_sp_body_saml: Use these for the SAML app, or give your provider the metadata URL.
sso_admin_sp_title: Register these with your identity provider
sso_admin_subtitle: Let staff sign in through your identity provider, require it, and provision staff accounts with SCIM. Investors are never affected.
sso_admin_switch_body: The new settings replace the old ones once they check out. Register the addresses below with your identity provider first.
sso_admin_test_binding_mismatch: The test finished in a different browser than it started in. Run it again in this browser.
sso_admin_test_expired: The test took too long. Start it again and finish within a few minutes.
sso_admin_test_failed_generic: The test did not complete. The last error below may say why.
sso_admin_test_help: A test sign-in goes to your identity provider and back, checks everything, and signs nobody in. It works while the connection is off.
sso_admin_test_idp_error: The identity provider refused the sign-in. Check the app's assignment and settings there.
sso_admin_test_invalid_response: The identity provider's response did not check out. The last error below says why.
sso_admin_test_ok_body: Your identity provider's response checked out. Nobody was signed in and no account was changed.
sso_admin_test_rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
sso_login_discovered_embedded: Your address signs in with your organisation's single sign-on, which can't run inside this page. Continue in a new tab.
sso_login_embedded_hint: Single sign-on opens the portal in a new tab.
sso_login_enforced_hint: Staff at {workspace} sign in with the company's single sign-on. Investors can still use their email address below.
sso_login_error_binding_mismatch: For your safety, single sign-on has to finish in the browser where it started. Start again in the same browser.
sso_login_error_disabled: Single sign-on is turned off for this workspace. Sign in another way, or contact an administrator.
sso_login_error_expired: The sign-in took too long. Start again.
sso_login_error_generic: Something went wrong with single sign-on. Start again.
sso_login_error_idp_error: Your identity provider didn't sign you in. Try again, or contact your administrator.
sso_login_error_invalid_response: We couldn't verify the answer from your identity provider. Try again, or ask your administrator to check the single sign-on setup.
sso_login_error_not_provisioned: Your account hasn't been set up in this workspace yet. Ask an administrator to add you.
sso_login_error_rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
sso_login_error_reauth_mismatch: You signed in again as a different person than the one using this session. Start again, signing in with the same account.
sso_login_error_reauth_required: Your identity provider didn't ask you to sign in again, so we couldn't confirm it's you. Try again.
sso_login_error_staff_only: Single sign-on is for the company's staff. Investors sign in with their email address below.
sso_login_error_suspended: Your access to this workspace is suspended. Contact an administrator.
sso_login_error_unknown_user: Your identity provider signed you in, but that account doesn't have access to this workspace. Ask an administrator to invite you.
sso_login_reauth_generic: Sign in again with single sign-on
sso_login_required_body: Staff at {workspace} must sign in through the company's single sign-on. Continue with it to pick up where you left off.
sso_login_required_error_body: Sign in with your organisation's single sign-on to continue.
sso_login_required_owner_link: Verify with a passkey or authenticator
sso_login_required_owner_note: Owners can still use a passkey or authenticator app to reach the workspace settings.
sso_login_session_restricted_body: This session came from single sign-on and can't change account security settings; sign in with your email to do this.
sso_login_session_restricted_title: Not available in a single sign-on session
sso_login_stepup_nothing: This session came from single sign-on, and there's no way to confirm it's you here right now. Sign out, then sign in again.
step_up_fresh_body: This action needs a fresh proof of identity. Confirm with one of the methods below.
step_up_key_unverified: That confirmation did not verify you: some security keys do not check a PIN or fingerprint. Confirm another way below, or with a passkey that asks for a PIN or biometric.
step_up_key_unverified_app: That confirmation did not verify you: some security keys do not check a PIN or fingerprint. Use your authenticator app or a recovery code instead.
step_up_key_unverified_central: That confirmation did not verify you: some security keys do not check a PIN or fingerprint. Choose Continue to confirm it's you on {instance}, where you can also add an authenticator app.
step_up_key_unverified_embed: That confirmation did not verify you: some security keys do not check a PIN or fingerprint. Continue in a new window, where you can confirm it's you another way.
step_up_key_unverified_short: That key did not confirm it's you.
step_up_key_unverified_sso: That confirmation did not verify you: this security key does not check a PIN or fingerprint, so it can't confirm it's you here. Use your authenticator app or a recovery code if you have one. Otherwise sign out, then sign in again with a key that checks a PIN or fingerprint, or ask your workspace administrator for help.
step_up_level_body: This area needs two-factor authentication. Confirm with a second factor to continue.
step_up_nothing_body: You haven't set up a passkey or an authenticator app yet, so there is nothing to confirm with.
step_up_popup_blocked: Your browser blocked that window. Allow pop-ups for this site, or use one of the methods below.
step_up_popup_body: Signing in again works best outside this frame. A passkey, in particular, can only run in a window of its own unless the site hosting this portal has explicitly allowed it.
step_up_popup_title: Do this in its own window
step_up_recovery_hint: One of the codes you saved when you set up two-factor authentication. Each works once.
totp_disable_body: Your account will no longer ask for a second factor.
totp_off_body: Add an authenticator app to protect your account with a second factor.
totp_qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
totp_recovery_body: Each code signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now.
totp_scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
totp_subtitle: A second factor from an app such as 1Password, Google Authenticator or Authy.
unlock_body: This one is behind an agreement. Read it, agree, and it opens — the rest of the room is unaffected either way.
unlock_done_body: Your agreement is on record and this document is open.
unlock_unavailable_body: This workspace has not published the agreement in a form this screen can show. Ask whoever runs the data room to send it to you.
unlock_unavailable_title: The text is not available here yet
unsubscribe_already: {email} was already unsubscribed from investor updates.
unsubscribe_done: {email} will no longer receive investor updates by email.
unsubscribe_missing: This link is missing its token. Open the link from the email again.
unsubscribe_note: You keep access to the portal and the update archive. Security notices about your account are not affected.
updates_actions_body: Test it on yourself first. Sending publishes an immutable version to the archive.
updates_admin_empty: No updates yet. Create one from a template.
updates_admin_subtitle: Write, send and archive investor updates.
updates_audience_body: Who receives the email and can open it in the archive.
updates_block_other: A {type} block. Edit it on the overview page editor or remove it.
updates_delete_confirm_body: It disappears from the archive. Sent versions and delivery records are kept for the audit trail.
updates_domain_body: Send from your own domain with DKIM. Publish the records at your DNS provider, then verify.
updates_domain_field_help: A subdomain such as mail.yourcompany.com is recommended.
updates_domain_not_yet: The DKIM record was not found yet. DNS changes can take a while.
updates_domain_remove_body: Updates go back to the platform's default sender.
updates_domain_set: Sending domain added. Publish the records, then verify.
updates_email_automated_hint: {n} in total. Mail privacy features and scanners open emails without a person; these are shown apart and never counted as reads.
updates_email_body: Unique people who opened this update or clicked a link in it. Recorded only in engagement mode, for people whose consent allows email tracking.
updates_email_mode_off: Opens and clicks are recorded only in engagement mode, so these may be incomplete.
updates_email_pref_body: Receive new updates by email. You can always read them here.
updates_email_pref_switch: Send me investor updates by email
updates_empty_body: Updates sent to you will appear here.
updates_footer_help: Confidentiality legend or disclaimer under every update.
updates_from_local_help: Used as <local part>@<your sending domain> once the domain is verified.
updates_from_name_help: Shown in the inbox. Defaults to the workspace name.
updates_new_body: Pick a template; you can change every section afterwards.
updates_postal_help: Printed in every update footer (sender identification rules).
updates_replies_body: Each investor has a private thread with the company.
updates_reply_body: Only the company sees your reply.
updates_reply_to_help: Where replies land. Defaults to the author of the update.
updates_schedule_body: The update is sent automatically at this time.
updates_send_confirm_all: Every investor who has not opted out receives it by email now. This cannot be undone.

match.nPlural=one: Members of {n} group who have not opted out receive it by email now. This cannot be undone.
match.nPlural=*: Members of {n} groups who have not opted out receive it by email now. This cannot be undone.

updates_sender_body: How update emails identify the company.
updates_sending_body: The update is being delivered. Editing resumes when the send finishes.
updates_sends_body: Every live and test send with per-recipient status.
updates_settings_forbidden: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
updates_settings_subtitle: Sender identity, reply-to, the legal footer and your own sending domain.
updates_subscribed_toast: You will receive updates by email
updates_subtitle: Investor updates from the company, newest first.
updates_test_send_body: A test goes to you (or the addresses below), shows every section and marks itself as a test.
updates_test_to_help: Optional, up to five, separated by commas. Defaults to your own address.
updates_unsubscribed_toast: You will no longer receive updates by email
verify_missing_email: Start again by entering your email address.
verify_subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to {email} if it can sign in here.
view_as_admin_body: While you view the portal as an investor, admin screens are not available: every request is answered as them. Exit the view from the banner to come back.
view_as_admin_title: You are viewing as an investor
view_as_banner: Viewing as {name} — read-only. Downloads are off and nothing you do is recorded as them. Ends at {time}.
view_as_dialog_body: You will see the portal exactly as they do, read-only, for 30 minutes. Downloads are off and nothing you do is recorded as them. The view and your reason are kept in the audit log.
view_as_reason_hint: Required, at least 3 characters. For example: checking what they can see in the data room.
webhooks_auto_disabled_failing: Twenty deliveries in a row failed after all their retries, so nothing more is sent. Fix the receiver, then switch the endpoint back on.
webhooks_auto_disabled_gone: The receiver answered 410 Gone, which means it no longer wants deliveries, so nothing more is sent. Switch it back on only if that was a mistake.
webhooks_auto_disabled_title: This endpoint was switched off automatically
webhooks_change_url_body: Deliveries go to the new address from now on, signed with the same secret. You may be asked to confirm it is you.
webhooks_create_body: Signed events are sent to this address as they happen. Use a URL only you and the receiving service know.
webhooks_created_title: Signing secret for {endpoint} — copy it now
webhooks_delete_body: Nothing more is sent to this endpoint and its delivery history is deleted. This cannot be undone.
webhooks_deliveries_body: What was sent to this endpoint in the last 30 days. Failed deliveries have used all their retries; you can send them again.
webhooks_delivery_body: What was sent and what the receiver answered.
webhooks_empty_body: Add an endpoint to have events such as a published update or a new commitment posted to another system, for example a Zapier or Make catch hook.
webhooks_error_endpoint_disabled: This endpoint is switched off. Switch it on before sending anything to it.
webhooks_error_rotation_in_progress: The previous secret is still valid while the last rotation's overlap runs. Wait until it ends, or rotate with no grace period to end it now.
webhooks_error_subject_erased: The member this event is about has had their data erased, so it cannot be sent again.
webhooks_error_too_many_endpoints: This workspace already has 20 endpoints. Delete one you no longer need, then try again.
webhooks_error_topic_unavailable: This event is no longer offered (its module is switched off, or the endpoint no longer subscribes to it), so it cannot be sent again.
webhooks_error_tracking_not_allowed: The member this event is about no longer allows tracking, so it cannot be sent again.
webhooks_error_url: That URL cannot be used. It must start with https:// and point to a public address.
webhooks_field_events_hint: Only events of the modules switched on in this workspace are offered.
webhooks_field_url_hint: Must start with https://. It is stored encrypted and never shown again in full.
webhooks_forbidden: Only workspace owners and admins can see webhooks.
webhooks_grace: Keep signing with the old secret for
webhooks_grace_hint: Until then every delivery carries two signatures, so the receiver can switch secrets without missing any.
webhooks_person_level_hint: Names a member, so it is sent only when that member's tracking consent allows it.
webhooks_read_only: You can see the endpoints and deliveries, but only someone who can manage webhooks can change them.
webhooks_rotate_body: A new signing secret is created. Put it in the receiving service before the old one stops being used.
webhooks_rotated_title: New signing secret — copy it now
webhooks_secret_rotating: Changing over: deliveries carry the new and the old signature
webhooks_settings_body: What this endpoint is for and which events it receives.
webhooks_subtitle: Endpoints this workspace sends signed events to, and what was delivered.
webhooks_test_queued: Test event queued. It appears under Deliveries once it is sent.
webhooks_topics_unavailable: No longer offered (the module is switched off)
webhooks_verify_hint: The receiver checks each delivery's signature with this secret, using the Standard Webhooks scheme (the SDK's verifyWebhook, or docs/api/webhooks.md in the FundRoom repository).
workspace_language_body: Used for members who have not chosen a language of their own, and for the emails they receive.
workspace_language_read_only: Only people who can change access settings can change this.
workspace_status_pending_review: We are running a standard check on new workspaces. It usually takes a few minutes, and everything entered so far is kept. The rest of the workspace opens once the check is done.
workspace_status_pending_review_billing: You can set up billing in the meantime.
workspace_status_suspended: This workspace is unavailable at the moment.
workspace_status_suspended_billing: This workspace is suspended because a payment is overdue. Settle it in Billing to restore it.
workspace_status_suspended_operator: Your host has suspended this workspace. Contact them to restore it.
workspace_status_suspended_relocation: Your host is moving this workspace to another data region. It is back as soon as the move is done.
workspace_status_suspended_review: This workspace is suspended following a compliance review by your host. Contact them for details.
